prompt: Spring Boot server.tomcat.processor-cache negative value behavior
answer:
Tomcat’s `processorCache` treats `-1` as **unlimited**; the default is `200`. A value of `0` disables processor reuse.  
[Tomcat HTTP Connector documentation](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-11.0-doc/config/http.html)

However, Spring Boot issue #16415 states that `server.tomcat.processor-cache` was only applied when positive, so configuring `-1` through that property could not enable Tomcat’s unlimited cache and would leave the default behavior in effect.  
[Spring Boot issue #16415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/16415)
